subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Gustave Eiffel, a French engineer, was famous for his expertise in designing iron structures. He started working after his graduation and became a prominent figure in France. In the 1880s, a group of French industrialists proposed the government to organize a World Fair in Paris, where he proposed to build a 989-feet iron tower, now known as the Eiffel Tower. The construction began in 1887 and was completed in 1889. Eiffel’s tower became a symbol of Paris, attracting people from around the world.
